{{Locations|Zoltan Controlled Sector|Zoltan Homeworlds|LRSmap=noship|unique=true}}


<onlyinclude>''You arrive at the primitive planet that you heard about at the cantina and are surprised to see a Zoltan ship facing off against a Rebel assault craft.''
* ''You tap into their frequency and hear the Rebel captain yelling, "We are liberating this planet in the name of the new Galactic government! These aliens will not be left in ignorance where they cannot be of use!"''
*# Interfere - make first contact with the primitive aliens.
*#* ''The local people - furry, one-eyed tree lizard things - begin chanting when they see you. Suddenly the sky is lit by laser fire - the Zoltan opened fire on your ship! You dash back to the shuttle and join the fight.''
*#** Fight the [[Zoltan Ships|Zoltan ship]].
*#*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|The Rebel contacts you. "Lovely, you've done our job for us! We'll let you live as thanks. However, I can't promise the fleet will show you the same courtesy." They jump off. You collect what you can from the remains of the Zoltan ship.}}
*#**** Rebel Fleet <span style="color:red">pursuit</span> is <span style="color:red">doubled</span> for <span style="color:red">1 jump</span> and you receive low [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
*#*** {{Winning|deadCrew=true|The Rebel contacts you. "Lovely, you've done our job for us! We'll let you live as thanks. However, I can't promise the fleet will show you the same courtesy." They jump off. You collect what you can from the remains of the Zoltan ship.}}
*#**** Rebel Fleet <span style="color:red">pursuit</span> is <span style="color:red">doubled</span> for <span style="color:red">1 jump</span> and you receive a random amount of [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
*# Protect the aliens' way of life - Attack the Rebel ship.
*#* ''These creatures should be left to develop at their own pace. You direct all weapons on the Rebel ship and begin the firing sequence.''
*#** Fight the [[Rebel Ships|Rebel Ship]].
*#*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|The Zoltan hail once the smoke disperses. "Thank you. We were led to believe Federation ideals died along with the Federation itself. Let us aid you a little, for old times' sake." You accept their reward and scrap, then collect some remains from the Rebel ship.}}
*#**** You receive a <span style="color:limegreen">weapon</span> with low <span style="color:#70b8ff">scrap</span>.
*#*** {{Winning|deadCrew=true|The Zoltan hail once the smoke disperses. "Thank you. We were led to believe Federation ideals died along with the Federation itself. Let us aid you a little, for old times' sake." You accept their reward and scrap, then collect some remains from the Rebel ship. }}
*#**** You receive a <span style="color:limegreen">weapon</span> with medium <span style="color:#70b8ff">scrap</span>.
*# Leave.
*#* ''You don't want to alert the Rebels of your presence and you don't want to anger the Zoltan in their territory. The best solution is to leave.''
*#** Nothing happens.</onlyinclude>

==Trivia==
This event is called "ZOLTAN_QUEST_PRIMITIVES" in the datafiles.
* This event can also be encountered as a quest in the [[Zoltan trade hub]] event.
* The Zoltan ship at the quest marker ("ZOLTAN_PRIMITIVES_ZOLTAN") doesn't have surrender/escape chances/requirements specified (events_ships.xml).
* The Rebel ship at the quest marker ("ZOLTAN_PRIMITIVES_REBEL") doesn't have surrender/escape chances/requirements specified (events_ships.xml).
